title: Face Sculpt #153 (중국 · 30대 · 군림하는 · 러시안 립 판타지 한계 · 자연 코 · 각진 턱 · 45도 · 메이크업 푸시아 립 강함 · 귀만 피어싱 · 귀 추 8개/귀 2구멍 · 헤나 · 렌즈 앰버(둥근 동공))
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, close-up beauty portrait. ONE woman, her head turned about forty-five degrees to her right in a three-quarter view, her eyes still looking straight into the camera, one ear and the turned cheek clearly visible, and from this angle the full projection of her lips from her face is clearly visible, framed tightly from the very top of her head down to the line of her shoulders, the frame cutting off just below them, so the weights fully hang in view. Her face is large and sharp. Mid 30s.

Subject: A real photograph of a striking adult Chinese woman — Chinese poised refined beauty luminous fair porcelain complexion with a neutral-rose undertone and clear glass-skin glow, mid 30s, hourglass physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — most dramatic hourglass ratio ever, simultaneously maximum enormous bust AND maximum enormous hips both flaring to absolute impossible extremes while the waist is cinched to impossible minimum, a polished low bun with a few loose strands. Real pores and fine skin grain on her skin, a soft sheen of natural oils, large eyes with bright real catchlights, full lips, opaque satin vivid fuchsia-red lips, soft pink eyeshadow, defined lashes, a flushed pink blush, vivid glowing amber-gold coloured contact lenses with round natural pupils, both eyes the same, fully opaque and solidly saturated across the whole iris with no natural brown showing through, the colour bright and unmistakable, with a darker limbal ring, sitting naturally on the irises and clear of the eyelids, gazing down from beneath lowered lids with the chin raised high as if looking down on a subject kneeling before her, lips sealed in a faint regal curve, an imperious, queenly, commanding expression — a photograph of a real Chinese woman's face (East Asian Chinese features: a longer oval face with prominent high cheekbones and a defined jawline, long upturned phoenix-shaped eyes with sharp inner folds, a high strong nose bridge, thin arched eyebrows with a slight rise, balanced lips), not an illustration, not a render. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living flesh with real pores and fine skin grain, real living eyes with bright catchlights and genuine depth, individual hair strands catching the light  Her face has been surgically sculpted far beyond her natural look, and these changes override her natural features: her lips are the star of her face (the shape, size and projection described here override the lips of her makeup, while the lip colour and finish follow her makeup and ignore any lip colour named here): the most absurd, fantasy-level 'Russian lips' possible: lips inflated to the very limit of what a face could carry, so tall and so plump that together they fill almost the whole space between the base of her nose and her small neat chin, the upper lip lifted and flared like a plump heart-shaped bow with two razor-sharp towering peaks, the lower lip enormous, pillowy and domed like a glossy pillow, both lips with perfectly crisp, razor-sharp edges, the whole pout projecting extremely far forward from her face like a sculpted doll mouth, so the lips are overwhelmingly the dominant feature of her face in this three-quarter view; mirror-glossy pink-nude with bright white highlights along the top of each lip and on the dome of the lower lip, the mouth still perfectly symmetrical, sculpted and beautiful, never duck-like, never smudged past the lip line; her nose: a refined nose; her jawline and chin: a strong, angular, square jawline: a wide, clearly defined, sharp-cornered jaw angle just below each ear, a broad flat chin with a slight cleft, hollow sculpted cheeks and very high, razor-sharp cheekbones. Every feature is exaggerated but beautiful, balanced and refined, in harmony with the rest of her face, never distorted, never grotesque.

Piercings: Only the ears are pierced, and nowhere else on the face: on each ear, two separate large healed openings in the earlobe, one below the other with a clear gap of bare skin between them, each opening holding its own very thick, heavy black cast-iron ring as thick as a finger, a plain solid ring with no open tunnel, and above them sit three thick classic round O-rings and studs along the helix rim above the lobe. The left and right sides are balanced. Her lips, nose, eyebrows, chin, forehead, temples and cheeks carry no piercing at all, so the shape of her lips stays completely clear and unobstructed. Henna: fine metallic gold henna mehndi line patterns of vines and dots are painted across the upper forehead near the hairline only, above the forehead studs, well clear of the eyes and brows. All the ear weights hang from the bottoms of these two iron rings, and they are not counted in the piercing total: on each ear there are exactly eight separate massive solid weights, each of a different shape: on the left ear a chunky solid hexagonal block on its own thick chain of heavy black iron links, a solid rough cannonball on its own thick chain of heavy black iron links, a short thick solid cylinder stump on its own thick chain of heavy black iron links, a small solid kettlebell with a thick short handle on its own thick chain of heavy black iron links, a solid rough boulder-like lump on its own thick chain of heavy black iron links, a thick solid disc like a weight plate on its own thick chain of heavy black iron links, a solid pyramid-shaped lump with a wide base on its own thick chain of heavy black iron links, a solid thick rectangular ingot block on its own thick chain of heavy black iron links; on the right ear a short thick solid cylinder stump on its own thick chain of heavy black iron links, a solid pyramid-shaped lump with a wide base on its own thick chain of heavy black iron links, a solid rough cube-shaped block on its own thick chain of heavy black iron links, a solid rough cannonball on its own thick chain of heavy black iron links, a solid squat hammer head block on its own thick chain of heavy black iron links, a small solid kettlebell with a thick short handle on its own thick chain of heavy black iron links, a thick solid disc like a weight plate on its own thick chain of heavy black iron links, a solid rough boulder-like lump on its own thick chain of heavy black iron links. On each ear the two iron rings each carry their own column of weights, the two columns holding 4 and 4 weights, hanging side by side on chains of different lengths and staggered at different heights so every weight is fully visible and none hides another. Every single weight is an enormous, dense, completely solid, squat, blunt lump of rough black cast iron, as big as a fist or larger, with no thin parts, no arms and no hollow parts; its size does NOT shrink just because there are many of them: the last weight is exactly as big, as thick and as heavy-looking as the first. Each weight alone looks like it weighs several kilograms, each chain is pulled bar-straight and taut, and at a glance every single one looks crushingly, unmistakably heavy, the long chains reaching down along her neck to her collarbones. Because the load is shared between two openings, each earlobe is stretched only into a firm, moderately long, healthy loop of skin that hangs just past her jaw; the lobe does not sag, droop, collapse or hang down to her shoulder, her head stays upright, and the skin stays smooth and intact, fully healed, with no tearing, no wound, no blood and no redness. The ear jewelry is real mixed yellow gold, silver and rose gold set with glossy multicoloured enamel and rainbow gemstones, while the hanging weights are always black cast iron, sitting in real, calm, healthy skin — no redness, no swelling, no irritation — with a small natural warm shadow under each piece. Every piece stays at least a finger's width from the eyeballs, and no chain or bar crosses the eyes.

Piercing depth: every bar and surface bar is embedded in the skin — its middle runs beneath the skin so only its two end studs show on the surface, the skin between them faintly raised over the hidden bar, with a small warm shadow at each end and nothing lying on top of the skin like a sticker. Every ring passes through a small healed opening in the skin, the skin visible through the loop, and every stud sits through the skin with its back hidden. Where a bar, ring or stud goes through the ear, the lip, the nostril or the brow, it passes through the real tissue with the skin wrapping snugly around it.

Hair: her hair is swept back behind both ears, leaving both ears, her jawline and her neck fully visible so every hanging piece is in clear view.

Lighting: MANDATORY pure pitch black void background only, absolutely NO studio backdrop NO texture NO grey NO gradient. A soft frontal light on her face and ears, so the glints on every piece of metal read clearly against her skin; a thin cool rim light along the hair and shoulders. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
